FN-EJWTG29-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 461
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Security
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/24/2026
House Bill 461 as introduced could increase the financial obligations of Marion Military
Institute (MMI) by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to administer a law
enforcement training curriculum pursuant to the provisions of this bill, which presumably would
be offset, in part or in whole, by additional tuition and fees collected by MMI when enrolling
additional students in this program.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Peace
Officers' Standards and Training Commission (APOST) to adopt rules allowing MMI to be
recognized as a law enforcement training academy.
